Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on your earlier commitments: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12 (Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry) which is still blocked?
What did you finish, what are you doing next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.
If task 19 slips, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, is story 5 PCI scan exceptions work done, is bug 12 staging access pairing done, and is story 2 settlement file validation done, and what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock you with the platform team staging gateway access?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with Daniel on the staging access today.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker: waiting on the security review, and your commitment: I’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is task 14 done, and is story 1 done?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment to keep working on the payment retry story today.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the blocker where the sandbox was down, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised today were: task 19 may be flagged if it slips, platform team staging gateway access is blocking, security review is pending, and the sandbox was down. We also parked an offline topic about gateway timeouts and configuration between sandbox and staging. Items not covered were story 3 and task 15, and their owners will get a follow-up about them. Follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses, are coming in Teams—thank you, everyone.
